# step fixture

One collection for `step.test.mjs` (adrs#647 c6329948739): thread evaluations (`atlas-eval`, held outside the owner
source), the owner source's comments (`owner.comments.json`: a readback, an evaluation, one written by an App), cold,
a snapshot that could not be read, a row held by authority (a decider's evaluation), and a plan no ideal state declares.
Built from the existing G fixtures (`collect/fixtures`).
